notes: The 16 DONE weapons now have a dedicated canonical weapon catalog; their cleaned FEHA description cards are the source of truth for weapon stats.
World and actor-owned copies are migrated so actual Foundry damage, range, native price, company metadata, class, and Market metadata match the canonical description.
Canonical weapon sheet metadata now includes reload actions, magazine size, Strength requirement, exact damage formula, normal/long range, technology, manufacturer, and structured special-rule data.
All weapon damage uses an exact custom Foundry formula so unusual campaign dice such as d2 and d30 remain legal and roll exactly as written.

Bastion DONE weapons: Breachhound 14d2 10/20 ft; Crusher 20d2 15/30 ft; Hexburst 6d8 60 ft; Igla 12d2 20 ft; Lexington 4d6 30 ft; Liberty 1d30 40 ft; Overture 2d20 40/180 ft; Saratoga 8d6 30 ft; Tactician 30d2 15 ft; Umbra 3d8 90 ft; Unity 5d6 30 ft; Warwake 8d10 50 ft.
Corvus DONE weapons: Ashura 3d12 200 ft; Dian 5d6 40/80 ft; Kyokokukamusari 4d8 60/180 ft; Masamune 5d8 60/180 ft.
Legacy description mistakes are removed, including Hexburst Neon/Warwake Neon labels, Kyokokukamusari displaying Masamune as its profile title, and stale manufacturer assignments.
Corvus special rules are rewritten into readable rules text: Ashura neural optic, Dian camera dart, Kyokokukamusari flashbang magazine, and Masamune neural relay.
Weapon Readiness now recognizes the canonical weapon catalog so DONE/NOT DONE organization and Market eligibility cannot drift away from finished sheet definitions.
